svg.title: Pull the lamp chain or cord.
svg.desc: Original task photograph with illustrative motion arrows.

g.title: Pull the hanging lamp cord downward.

svg.title: Open the top drawer, pick up the toy lion, and put it in the drawer.
svg.desc: Original task photograph with illustrative motion arrows.

g.title: Pull the top drawer outward from its handle, toward the lower right in the image.
Lift the orange toy lion from the shelf and place it in the opened top drawer.

svg.title: Fold the towel diagonally, bringing the lower-left corner to the upper-right corner.
svg.desc: Original task photograph with illustrative motion arrows.

g.title: Diagonal fold axis between the two stationary corners.
Bring the lower-left corner of the towel to its upper-right corner.

svg.title: Pull a wipe out of the container and clean the black mark.
svg.desc: Original task photograph with illustrative motion arrows.

g.title: Pull out the exposed wipe and bring it to the black mark.
Wipe back and forth over the marked area.

svg.title: Open the basket lid.
svg.desc: Original task photograph with illustrative motion arrows.

g.title: Lift the front edge of the basket lid upward and back.
